theory SD_JWT_Selective_Disclosure_Security

begin

// Function signature and definition of the equational theory E

functions: fst/1, h/1, pair/2, pk/1, sign/2, snd/1, true/0, verify/3
equations:
    fst(<x.1, x.2>) = x.1,
    snd(<x.1, x.2>) = x.2,
    verify(sign(x.1, x.2), x.1, pk(x.2)) = true

restriction Equality:
  "∀ x y #i. (Eq( x, y ) @ #i) ⇒ (x = y)"
  // safety formula

  /*
  expanded formula:
  "∀ x y #i. (Eq( x, y ) @ #i) ⇒ (x = y)"
  */

restriction Inequality:
  "∀ x y #i. (Neq( x, y ) @ #i) ⇒ (¬(x = y))"
  // safety formula

  /*
  expanded formula:
  "∀ x y #i. (Neq( x, y ) @ #i) ⇒ (¬(x = y))"
  */

restriction Unique:
  "∀ x #i #j. ((Unique( x ) @ #i) ∧ (Unique( x ) @ #j)) ⇒ (#i = #j)"
  // safety formula

  /*
  expanded formula:
  "∀ x #i #j. ((Unique( x ) @ #i) ∧ (Unique( x ) @ #j)) ⇒ (#i = #j)"
  */

rule (modulo E) Issuer_Keygen:
   [ Fr( ~isk ) ]
  --[ Issuer_Key( $Issuer, pk(~isk) ), Unique( <'issuer_key', $Issuer> )
  ]->
   [
   !Issuer_SK( $Issuer, ~isk ), !Issuer_PK( $Issuer, pk(~isk) ),
   Out( pk(~isk) )
   ]

  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

rule (modulo E) Holder_Keygen:
   [ Fr( ~hsk ) ]
  --[ Holder_Key( $Holder, pk(~hsk) ), Unique( <'holder_key', $Holder> )
  ]->
   [
   !Holder_SK( $Holder, ~hsk ), !Holder_PK( $Holder, pk(~hsk) ),
   Out( pk(~hsk) )
   ]

  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

rule (modulo E) Issuer_Issue:
   [
   !Issuer_SK( $Issuer, ~isk ), !Holder_PK( $Holder, holder_pk ),
   Fr( ~salt_a ), Fr( ~salt_b ), Fr( ~value_a ), Fr( ~value_b )
   ]
  --[
  Issued( $Issuer, $Holder,
          sign(<'sd_jwt', h(<~salt_a, $name_a, ~value_a>), 
                h(<~salt_b, $name_b, ~value_b>), holder_pk>,
               ~isk),
          <~salt_a, $name_a, ~value_a>, <~salt_b, $name_b, ~value_b>
  ),
  Issuer_Committed( $Issuer, $name_a, ~value_a,
                    h(<~salt_a, $name_a, ~value_a>)
  ),
  Issuer_Committed( $Issuer, $name_b, ~value_b,
                    h(<~salt_b, $name_b, ~value_b>)
  ),
  Salt_Fresh( ~salt_a ), Salt_Fresh( ~salt_b ),
  Unique( <'salt', ~salt_a> ), Unique( <'salt', ~salt_b> )
  ]->
   [
   Holder_Has_SdJwt( $Holder, $Issuer,
                     sign(<'sd_jwt', h(<~salt_a, $name_a, ~value_a>), 
                           h(<~salt_b, $name_b, ~value_b>), holder_pk>,
                          ~isk),
                     <~salt_a, $name_a, ~value_a>, <~salt_b, $name_b, ~value_b>
   ),
   !Issued_Digest( $Issuer, h(<~salt_a, $name_a, ~value_a>),
                   <~salt_a, $name_a, ~value_a>
   ),
   !Issued_Digest( $Issuer, h(<~salt_b, $name_b, ~value_b>),
                   <~salt_b, $name_b, ~value_b>
   )
   ]

  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

rule (modulo E) Holder_Present_A:
   [
   Holder_Has_SdJwt( $Holder, $Issuer, jwt, disc_a, disc_b ),
   !Holder_SK( $Holder, ~hsk )
   ]
  --[
  Presented( $Holder, $Issuer, jwt, disc_a ), Withheld( $Holder, disc_b )
  ]->
   [ Out( <jwt, disc_a, sign(<'kb_jwt', jwt, disc_a>, ~hsk)> ) ]

  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

rule (modulo E) Holder_Present_B:
   [
   Holder_Has_SdJwt( $Holder, $Issuer, jwt, disc_a, disc_b ),
   !Holder_SK( $Holder, ~hsk )
   ]
  --[
  Presented( $Holder, $Issuer, jwt, disc_b ), Withheld( $Holder, disc_a )
  ]->
   [ Out( <jwt, disc_b, sign(<'kb_jwt', jwt, disc_b>, ~hsk)> ) ]

  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

rule (modulo E) Verifier_Accept_Slot_A:
   [
   In( <sign(<'sd_jwt', h(<salt, name, value>), digest_b, holder_pk>, isk), 
        <salt, name, value>, 
        sign(<'kb_jwt', 
              sign(<'sd_jwt', h(<salt, name, value>), digest_b, holder_pk>, isk), 
              salt, name, value>,
             hsk)
       >
   ),
   !Issuer_PK( $Issuer, pk(isk) )
   ]
  --[
  Eq( holder_pk, pk(hsk) ),
  Verified_Claim( $Issuer, name, value, h(<salt, name, value>) ),
  Verified_Presentation( $Issuer,
                         sign(<'sd_jwt', h(<salt, name, value>), digest_b, holder_pk>, isk),
                         <salt, name, value>
  )
  ]->
   [ ]

  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

rule (modulo E) Verifier_Accept_Slot_B:
   [
   In( <sign(<'sd_jwt', digest_a, h(<salt, name, value>), holder_pk>, isk), 
        <salt, name, value>, 
        sign(<'kb_jwt', 
              sign(<'sd_jwt', digest_a, h(<salt, name, value>), holder_pk>, isk), 
              salt, name, value>,
             hsk)
       >
   ),
   !Issuer_PK( $Issuer, pk(isk) )
   ]
  --[
  Eq( holder_pk, pk(hsk) ),
  Verified_Claim( $Issuer, name, value, h(<salt, name, value>) ),
  Verified_Presentation( $Issuer,
                         sign(<'sd_jwt', digest_a, h(<salt, name, value>), holder_pk>, isk),
                         <salt, name, value>
  )
  ]->

  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

lemma disclosure_non_forgeability:
  all-traces
  "∀ Issuer name value digest #i.
    (Verified_Claim( Issuer, name, value, digest ) @ #i) ⇒
    (∃ #j.
      (Issuer_Committed( Issuer, name, value, digest ) @ #j) ∧ (#j < #i))"
/*
guarded formula characterizing all counter-examples:
"∃ Issuer name value digest #i.
  (Verified_Claim( Issuer, name, value, digest ) @ #i)
 ∧
  ∀ #j.
   (Issuer_Committed( Issuer, name, value, digest ) @ #j) ⇒ ¬(#j < #i)"
*/
by sorry

lemma selective_privacy:
  all-traces
  "∀ Holder disc_b #i.
    (Withheld( Holder, disc_b ) @ #i) ⇒ (¬(∃ #j. K( disc_b ) @ #j))"
/*
guarded formula characterizing all counter-examples:
"∃ Holder disc_b #i.
  (Withheld( Holder, disc_b ) @ #i) ∧ ∃ #j. (K( disc_b ) @ #j)"
*/
by sorry

lemma binding_integrity:
  all-traces
  "∀ Issuer name1 value1 name2 value2 digest #i #j.
    ((Verified_Claim( Issuer, name1, value1, digest ) @ #i) ∧
     (Verified_Claim( Issuer, name2, value2, digest ) @ #j)) ⇒
    ((name1 = name2) ∧ (value1 = value2))"
/*
guarded formula characterizing all counter-examples:
"∃ Issuer name1 value1 name2 value2 digest #i #j.
  (Verified_Claim( Issuer, name1, value1, digest ) @ #i) ∧
  (Verified_Claim( Issuer, name2, value2, digest ) @ #j)
 ∧
  ((¬(name1 = name2)) ∨ (¬(value1 = value2)))"
*/
by sorry

lemma no_disclosure_without_key:
  all-traces
  "∀ Issuer jwt disc #i.
    (Verified_Presentation( Issuer, jwt, disc ) @ #i) ⇒
    (∃ Holder #j. (Presented( Holder, Issuer, jwt, disc ) @ #j) ∧ (#j < #i))"
/*
guarded formula characterizing all counter-examples:
"∃ Issuer jwt disc #i.
  (Verified_Presentation( Issuer, jwt, disc ) @ #i)
 ∧
  ∀ Holder #j. (Presented( Holder, Issuer, jwt, disc ) @ #j) ⇒ ¬(#j < #i)"
*/
by sorry

lemma salt_uniqueness:
  all-traces
  "∀ s #i #j.
    ((Salt_Fresh( s ) @ #i) ∧ (Salt_Fresh( s ) @ #j)) ⇒ (#i = #j)"
/*
guarded formula characterizing all counter-examples:
"∃ s #i #j. (Salt_Fresh( s ) @ #i) ∧ (Salt_Fresh( s ) @ #j) ∧ ¬(#i = #j)"
*/
by sorry

lemma no_disclosure_without_salt:
  all-traces
  "∀ Holder salt name value #i.
    (Withheld( Holder, <salt, name, value> ) @ #i) ⇒
    (¬(∃ #j. K( salt ) @ #j))"
/*
guarded formula characterizing all counter-examples:
"∃ Holder salt name value #i.
  (Withheld( Holder, <salt, name, value> ) @ #i) ∧ ∃ #j. (K( salt ) @ #j)"
*/
by sorry

lemma presentation_verified_reachable:
  exists-trace
  "∃ issuer jwt disc #i. Verified_Presentation( issuer, jwt, disc ) @ #i"
/*
guarded formula characterizing all satisfying traces:
"∃ issuer jwt disc #i. (Verified_Presentation( issuer, jwt, disc ) @ #i)"
*/
